projects.name: AI Tray
projects.tagline: Desktop AI helpers that stay out of the way
projects.description: AI Tray provides lightweight desktop assistants for everyday workflows — summarization, drafting, and quick actions — with a focus on privacy-conscious local and remote model options.

showcase.problem: Desktop AI tools are often heavyweight or browser-bound, interrupting focus when you only need a quick summary or draft.
showcase.solution: A lightweight tray companion that keeps common AI actions one gesture away while respecting local and remote model choices.

features.title: Quick actions
features.description: Summarize, draft, and transform text without leaving your flow.

features.title: Privacy-conscious options
features.description: Prefer local models when possible; remote providers remain optional.

demo.note: Tray demo build is not available on the public showcase yet.

showcase.contributing: Ideas for tray actions and model adapters are welcome via issues.

projects.name: Document Platform
projects.tagline: Structured documents for modern product teams
projects.description: Document Platform is an RSProjects product for authoring, organizing, and shipping living product documentation. It emphasizes clear content models, multi-format export, and workflows that keep engineering and product writing in sync.

showcase.problem: Product and engineering documentation often lives in disconnected tools—wikis, tickets, and ad-hoc markdown—making it hard to keep structure, ownership, and shipping formats aligned as teams grow.
showcase.solution: Document Platform provides a shared content model, authoring workflows, and export paths so living docs stay consistent from draft to delivery across web and desktop.

features.title: Structured content model
features.description: Typed document schemas keep sections, metadata, and ownership explicit.

features.title: Multi-format export
features.description: Ship the same source as web, printable, and engineering-friendly formats.

features.title: Cross-team workflows
features.description: Review loops that keep product writing and engineering updates in sync.

features.title: Cross-platform clients
features.description: Primary web experience with desktop companions for focused writing.

demo.note: Interactive demo is planned for a later release. Use Documentation for current guidance.

screenshots.caption: Structured editor with section outline and metadata
Multi-format export from a single content source

media.caption: Structured editor with section outline and metadata
Short walkthrough planned when demo assets land

showcase.architecture: Feature-first Flutter clients consume a content registry and document APIs. Domain models stay free of UI; presentation uses a shared showcase template so every RSProjects product page follows the same structure.

architectureDiagram.caption: Content → domain → Riverpod → generic showcase UI

showcase.installation: Clone the repository, run flutter pub get, then flutter run -d chrome for the web client. Desktop targets follow the same Flutter toolchain.

examples.title: Product brief template
examples.description: Starter schema for problem, solution, and success metrics.

examples.title: API changelog note
examples.description: Structured release notes that export to eng and support channels.

benchmarks.label: Cold open (web)
benchmarks.note: Target budget on mid-tier laptop; not a published measurement yet

changelog.notes: Beta content model, multi-platform clients, and showcase metadata for the public portal.
Initial structured authoring workflows and export stubs.

showcase.contributing: Issues and pull requests are welcome on the public RSProjects repositories. Prefer content and schema changes that keep the showcase template generic—avoid project-specific UI forks.

projects.name: Localization Analyzer
projects.tagline: Find missing and unused localization keys
projects.description: Localization Analyzer scans Flutter ARB and localization usage to surface missing keys, unused entries, and consistency issues across locales before they reach production.

showcase.problem: Localization drift—missing keys, unused entries, and locale inconsistencies—often appears only after QA or production releases.
showcase.solution: A desktop analyzer that scans ARB files and Dart usage to report gaps early in the development loop.

features.title: Missing key detection
features.description: Compare usage against ARB definitions across locales.

features.title: Unused entry reports
features.description: Find keys that no longer appear in code.

demo.note: CLI/desktop demo packaging is not published yet.

showcase.installation: Install via the upcoming desktop package or run from source with Flutter on macOS, Linux, or Windows.
showcase.contributing: Report false positives and locale edge cases via GitHub issues.
